terms.meaning: the browser's built-in grid markup made of rows and cells

sections.name: File setup (part 1)
sections.title: Table wrapper, header, body and footer
sections.what: Creates the scroll wrapper and the table, header, body and footer parts, with borders and small spacing.
sections.why: Likely reason: the wrapper lets wide tables scroll sideways on phones.
sections.watch_out: The header and body borders come from these parts, so using a bare table element loses them.

sections.name: File setup (part 2)
sections.title: Rows and cells
sections.what: Creates table rows, header cells, data cells and captions, with a hover highlight and alignment that suits checkboxes.
sections.why: Likely reason: hover feedback and fixed alignment help readability.
sections.watch_out: A row only looks selected if the parent sets the selected state attribute on it.

sections.name: File setup (part 3)
sections.title: Exports the table pieces for other screens
sections.what: Makes the table building blocks available to other parts of the app. Screens import these names and assemble them into a data table with a header, body, footer, rows, cells and a caption.
sections.why: Reason not stated in the code. The file only re-exports parts defined above it.
sections.watch_out: Renaming or removing any name here breaks every screen that imports it.

summary: Provides styled building blocks for data tables: the table, header, body, footer, rows, cells and captions.
purpose: Lets screens show data in a grid with consistent styling.
why: Likely reason: plain table markup is wrapped with styles and a scroll wrapper so wide tables fit narrow screens.
how: The outer wrapper allows horizontal scrolling. The table, header, body, footer, rows, header cells, data cells and caption each add spacing, borders or a hover highlight.
inputs: Rows and cells as children, plus standard attributes.
risks: Wide tables scroll sideways inside the wrapper, not the whole page. This review covers only lines 1 to 110; the section for lines 111 to 120 was not in the packet, so its notes are missing.
debug: If columns are cut off, check the wrapper's scrolling. If rows do not highlight, check the row's hover or selected classes.
